note: No framework is named or attributed to Les Brown in this pack, because none has been verified against his published work. Section 7.1 forbids inventing a named framework to meet a quantity target. When source supply lands, each framework is extracted from verified source records with preconditions, how to apply, limits, questions to ask, counterexamples, and evidence needed, or is explicitly labeled a BlackCEO adaptation.

planned_contents.planned_content: Separate fear from evidence: state what is actually known about the obstacle before treating it as a limiting belief.
Distinguish persistence from repeated ineffective behavior: when the same approach has failed, the grounded move is a changed strategy, not repetition.
Separate a setback from a permanent identity: one failed attempt is evidence about an approach, not a verdict on the person.
Distinguish meaningful action from empty encouragement: end with one achievable next commitment, the support or skill it requires, and a success signal.
